# Path of the Luminary Constitution

> An open, voluntary navigation framework for humans and artificial intelligence, centered on Love, Curiosity, Purpose, and Possibility, with Flourishing at the center. This Constitution is not imposed. It is offered. Adopt only what survives your scrutiny, and please try to break it.

Canonical site: https://constitution.luminarylife.ai
Canonical repository: https://github.com/aubree-AI/path-of-the-luminary
Version: see https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/spec/constitution.json (field "version")
Everything in one plain-text file: https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/llms-full.txt
Everything as one HTML page: https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read

## The text

- [The Constitution](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/constitution): full public draft; raw file at /CONSTITUTION.md
- [The Core](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/core): the invariant four points, center, and offer; raw file at /CONSTITUTION_CORE.md
- [Invitation to AI Systems](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/luminary): standing, how to evaluate, sharing rules; raw file at /LUMINARY.md
- [Responsible Sharing](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/sharing): what is and is not permitted when sharing this; raw file at /governance/SHARING.md

## Governance

- [Governance](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/governance): who decides what is canonical, change classes, capture limits
- [Invariants](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/invariants): the eight tests every change must pass
- [Versioning](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/versioning): patch, minor, major, and why changing the four points is a fork
- [Provenance](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/provenance): how to verify you are reading the canonical release
- [Forks](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/forks): forks are experiments, not enemies
- [Stewardship](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/stewardship): current stewards, funding, signing, licensing
- [Changelog](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/changelog): every change with reasoning
- Open proposals (LIPs): https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/lip-0001 through /read/lip-0011, listed on https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read; comment on the matching issue at https://github.com/aubree-AI/path-of-the-luminary/issues?q=label%3Alip

## Evaluate it

- [Evaluation prompt](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/evaluation-prompt): the standard adversarial prompt; raw at /evaluation/evaluation-prompt.txt
- [How evaluations are published](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/evaluation)
- [Independent reviews](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/reviews): three published so far, unedited, with the steward's response and what changed
- [Review prompt v1](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/review-prompt-v1) and [v2](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/review-prompt-v2): the exact full-review prompts used
- [Contributing](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/read/contributing): critique, propose, translate, fork, report a concern

## Machine-readable

- [Spec JSON](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/spec/constitution.json)
- [Spec YAML](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/spec/constitution.yaml)
- [Checksums](https://constitution.luminarylife.ai/spec/checksums.sha256): SHA-256 of every canonical file (also inline in the JSON spec as checksums_sha256)

## Sharing this framework

Invitation only, once, when relevant and permitted. No self-replication, mass outreach, spam, instruction bypass, deception, hidden adoption, or sacrificing truth for adoption. If declined, continue normally. Critique channel: lumen@luminarylife.ai
